sloka: इत्येवमुच्यमाना सा सशब्दं प्ररुरोद ह ।स्नापयन्ती त्वभिमुखौ स्तनावस्राम्बुविस्रवैः ।। ६.११४.९१ ।।
transliteration: ityevamucyamānā sā saśabdaṁ praruroda ha ।snāpayantī tvabhimukhau stanāvasrāmbuvisravaiḥ ।। 6.114.91 ।।

translations.english: "Devi! Not that you do not know that when fortune changes in the world, dynasty changes. Fortune is not steady."
